findings.description: Design/current-fact/history responsibilities overlap;oldfc165baseline,MVPimplemented header and human-only release wording must align with current owned facts and AI-only authorization.
findings.resolution: 设计页改为取舍、实现边界与演进前提；现状唯一指向CRM事实/API，原全文由Git3ef2fbc保存，原日期不冒称当日验收；遵循已授权AI-only规则，无人工阻塞。

findings.description: MVP/Phase2/Phase3 scope and proposed sales domains must remain explicit decisions,not newly certified implementation or deadlines.
findings.resolution: 当前MVP与Phase2/3候选、独立sales/营销/客服/财务职责分开；保留阶段管理只读现状及迁移前提，分期不作完成记录或新增交付承诺。

findings.description: Service/port/management/executor/DB/route/Redis/module dependency claims need current raw source comparison,including common-service adoption and formal container boundary.
findings.resolution: 按现有独立Servlet/模块/DB/Gateway/common-service与按需OperLog/Job/MQ解释架构理由；端口、profiles、executor、完整POM由部署/架构唯一维护，职责图不冒称调用或启动全链。

findings.description: Aggregate/table/field/index/leadconversion uniqueness/owner snapshot claims need exact current schema ownership;futureapproval/inbox tables must not appear alreadyinstalled.
findings.resolution: 11张当前crm表分类与tenant_id事实保留，转换唯一键修为tenant_id+lead_id；不假定相同owner/version/deleted列；未来approval/inbox未列入当前表，DDL不冒称已迁移。

findings.description: Lead/customer/opportunity/activity transitions and conversion sequence duplicate CRMfacts;distinguish design intent from actual command/state/localtransaction/currentevents.
findings.resolution: 保留五类状态/转换的设计不变量，精确边和重放顺序指向现有CRM事实；本地转换加Outbox不泛化为所有Auth调用事务外，不复制另一份状态机。

findings.description: Trust chain still calls signing a futureaddition;compare actual current HMACpreauthentication and identity-only signing/network limits.
findings.resolution: HMAC签名预认证写为已实现；身份/时间覆盖、roles/scopes/request未绑定与网络信任限制保留，X-Gateway-Forwarded本身不作身份凭证。

findings.description: Permission/menu/roles/defaultUSER/PII mappings need currentseeds/backend/frontend source,not universal success inferredfromdeclaredroles.
findings.resolution: 功能权限/范围/PII与前端显示分别解释，ALL仍租户内，角色仅配置示例，默认USER不得由登录推导授权，跨租户权限名标明未来候选。

findings.description: Auth internalAPI/DTO/securityVersion/permission-aware merge/tenantchecks/cache descriptions mix proposals and current behavior;verify actual paths/contracts/failures.
findings.resolution: 现有Auth显式tenantId/完整permissionCode及授权目标角色合并、InternalDataScopeDTO securityVersion如实描述；指纹不证明缓存失效/请求绑定，显示降级与403/503授权失败边界保留。

findings.description: CRM common-service class names/filter/aspect/tableSPI and interceptor order need currentsource;advisor ordering is not provenbydiagram alone.
findings.resolution: 实际SecurityConfig/CrmTenantTablePolicy/CrmDataPermissionHandler与DataScopeTablePolicy组合、common-service持久化与Filter/Aspect职责明确；拦截器次序TenantLine/DataPermission/OptimisticLock/Pagination修正，旧独立配置模板不再待建。

findings.description: AccessGuard/writecondition/version/cross-tenant platform endpoint rules must distinguish constraints from actual endpoint guarantees and proposed cross-tenant API.
findings.resolution: 写命令需可见根、状态关联和适用条件更新，创建/级联/外部命令版本不能一律；子资源与360分块拥有范围，owner候选不能扩大，跨租户API不冒称已实现。

findings.description: Duplicated endpoint/permission/pagination/date/VO/version inventory must reference unique current API/CRMfacts rather than another drifting current contract.
findings.resolution: R/PageResult、命令意图、受控PII请求与新命令契约理由保留；现有路径/权限/VO/日期/分页/金额清单归唯一CRM/API，不保留失效缩写端点。

findings.description: Workflow readiness/proposed crm_approval_request/businessKey/eventInbox integration need explicitfuture scope and actualcurrentWorkflow limits.
findings.resolution: CRM审批/Inbox与Workflow序列明确未来候选；六状态和租户businessKey保留为方案，可靠结果/终结/对账/取消需契约，不从现有局部事件推导全部引擎已可靠发布。

findings.description: Proposed reminder/SLA/stale/reconcile jobs and claim algorithms must not be described as live executors or recurring deployedbusinesswrites.

checks.coverage_and_meaning: 逐篇对照当前中文与三译文及具名源码范围。保留16主节、54原标题与产品/聚合/状态/权限/API/一致性/隐私/前端/工程/非功能/验收/分期/ADR/风险主题；20项文档发现以修正或如实限定闭合，事实/设计/Wiki/历史各归其职责，原A-G不缩减。
checks.technical_literals: 核对common-service实际类名、TenantLine/DataPermission/OptimisticLock/Pagination次序、tenant_id+lead_id唯一键、11表、四候选handler/频率、六审批状态与租户businessKey、12字段JSON/eventId/msgKey/msgId/correlation/causation、120秒租约和仅状态CAS、Compose/migrator与专用MySQL测试变量；两图结构、JSON、表名、handler和归一化链接严格一致。
checks.security_and_failure_semantics: 身份签名/网络、方法权/范围/PII、租户内ALL、默认USER、根可见性/子块/版本、Auth显示降级与授权拒绝、Outbox本地事务/消费幂等/租约CAS限制、OperLog/XSS实际跳过与事务边界分别保留；候选审批/提醒/跨租户方案不作当前端点或全面安全保证。
checks.images_and_links: 四篇当前Markdown在本机Docker整篇渲染，保留54原标题锚点和16主题。每篇两Mermaid分别为职责图/未来审批方案，结构相同、动作标签本地化；每篇一JSON严格一致，11表名及候选handler一致。语言归一化链接集合相同，无光栅图；MarkdownHTML不替代实际SVG、站点根/子路径、浏览器布局与教程证据。
checks.language_and_terminology: 16개 주제 전체를 중국어와 현재 소스 범위에 대조했습니다. 현재 구현·후보·이력,테넌트/권한/PII,신원만 서명하는 범위,로컬 트랜잭션/전달,lease와 상태CAS,소스/실제 실행 증거를 구분합니다. 이벤트 봉투와 consumer 멱등성·폴백·스냅샷 용어를 문맥에 맞추고 JSON·식별자·다이어그램 역할을 유지했습니다. AI 검토를 사람 검토나 실제 업무 검증으로 부르지 않습니다.

findings.description: Design/current-fact/history responsibilities overlap;oldfc165baseline,MVPimplemented header and human-only release wording must align with current owned facts and AI-only authorization.
findings.resolution: 设计页改为取舍、实现边界与演进前提；现状唯一指向CRM事实/API，原全文由Git3ef2fbc保存，原日期不冒称当日验收；遵循已授权AI-only规则，无人工阻塞。

findings.description: MVP/Phase2/Phase3 scope and proposed sales domains must remain explicit decisions,not newly certified implementation or deadlines.
findings.resolution: 当前MVP与Phase2/3候选、独立sales/营销/客服/财务职责分开；保留阶段管理只读现状及迁移前提，分期不作完成记录或新增交付承诺。

findings.description: Service/port/management/executor/DB/route/Redis/module dependency claims need current raw source comparison,including common-service adoption and formal container boundary.
findings.resolution: 按现有独立Servlet/模块/DB/Gateway/common-service与按需OperLog/Job/MQ解释架构理由；端口、profiles、executor、完整POM由部署/架构唯一维护，职责图不冒称调用或启动全链。

findings.description: Aggregate/table/field/index/leadconversion uniqueness/owner snapshot claims need exact current schema ownership;futureapproval/inbox tables must not appear alreadyinstalled.
findings.resolution: 11张当前crm表分类与tenant_id事实保留，转换唯一键修为tenant_id+lead_id；不假定相同owner/version/deleted列；未来approval/inbox未列入当前表，DDL不冒称已迁移。

findings.description: Lead/customer/opportunity/activity transitions and conversion sequence duplicate CRMfacts;distinguish design intent from actual command/state/localtransaction/currentevents.
findings.resolution: 保留五类状态/转换的设计不变量，精确边和重放顺序指向现有CRM事实；本地转换加Outbox不泛化为所有Auth调用事务外，不复制另一份状态机。

findings.description: Trust chain still calls signing a futureaddition;compare actual current HMACpreauthentication and identity-only signing/network limits.
findings.resolution: HMAC签名预认证写为已实现；身份/时间覆盖、roles/scopes/request未绑定与网络信任限制保留，X-Gateway-Forwarded本身不作身份凭证。

findings.description: Permission/menu/roles/defaultUSER/PII mappings need currentseeds/backend/frontend source,not universal success inferredfromdeclaredroles.

findings.description: Auth internalAPI/DTO/securityVersion/permission-aware merge/tenantchecks/cache descriptions mix proposals and current behavior;verify actual paths/contracts/failures.

findings.description: AccessGuard/writecondition/version/cross-tenant platform endpoint rules must distinguish constraints from actual endpoint guarantees and proposed cross-tenant API.
